note: Commits where the archive changed because the ARCHIVER changed, not because a publisher edited anything. These diffs are ours and are labelled as such on the site so they can never be mistaken for a company altering its own document. Detected by a commit touching both scripts/archive.mjs and archive/ — recorded here permanently rather than corrected by rewriting history, because an archive that edits its own past is not an archive.
